title: RSGManifest
description: Canonical export manifest of one RSG state (docs/07 §4, task T0206): the project's complete versioned research-state graph as of that state — every scientific object version and relation version in the state's lineage, the blob attachments on those object versions, the schema/policy references, the git ref and the state hash content-addressing the whole document. A server-produced export document, never a request DTO: the exporter (internal/rsg/manifest) renders it; do not bind a client-supplied body directly to it. The state_hash is sha256 over the canonical JSON of the manifest minus generated_at and state_hash (see internal/rsg/manifest for the canonical serialization rules).

format_version.description: The manifest format version, which doubles as the hash algorithm version record (docs/21 §10): a future algorithm is a new format version, never a silent rewrite of old hashes.

generated_at.description: Export timestamp (UTC). Export-time metadata: it moves between exports and is NOT part of the state_hash.

items.description: One schema reference as "<schema $id>@<schema version>", sorted and unique.

policy_refs.description: The visibility policy ids pinned by the object versions, sorted and unique.

object_versions.description: Every scientific object version whose state_id is the state or one of its ancestors, in canonical order ((object_id, version_no, id)).

payload.description: The versioned scientific content in canonical JSON (sorted keys, compact, numbers preserved).

relation_versions.description: Every relation version whose state_id is the state or one of its ancestors, in canonical order ((relation_id, version_no, id)).

payload.description: The edge's scope/metadata in canonical JSON.

blob_refs.description: The blob attachments whose own state_id is in the state's lineage AND whose owning object version is in the lineage: the attachment belongs to the state it was created in, never to the state of the version it attaches to, and every blob ref names a version present in the same manifest — an attachment committed in a later state, or pointing at a version outside the lineage, is not part of earlier states' manifests. Sorted by id. The manifest pins the reference, never the bytes (invariant 7).

hash.description: The blob's content hash as stored on blobs.content_hash.

git_ref.description: The GitProvider commit the state corresponds to: the state's own recorded git_commit_sha (project_states.git_commit_sha, set by the git-compat path), null when the state has none. The project's repository id is deliberately NOT part of the manifest — it is mutable project data, and a state's hash must be a pure function of the state's recorded content (the repository id is resolvable from the manifest's project_id through the project).

state_hash.description: The content address of the manifest: sha256 over the canonical JSON of every field except generated_at and state_hash. The algorithm prefix is part of the value (docs/21 §10).
